content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the USB clock being left uninitialized due to the EHCI driver improperly handling clock management. Specifically, the EHCI driver was retrieving and preparing the UHPCK clock, which in turn prepared its parent clock (the USB clock) that had the CLK_SET_RATE_GATE flag set. This flag prevented any rate changes once the clock was prepared, leading to the USB clock not being set to the required 48MHz, which is necessary for the OHCI driver to function correctly. The patch addresses this by removing unnecessary clock handling and ensuring the correct clocks are initialized and enabled.
